The application for finding the cheapest prices for air tickets allows you to:
• find the best deals from airlines;
• use the sorting of air tickets by price, departure, arrival, rating;
• use convenient filters when choosing airline tickets: (morning, afternoon, evening), by the number of transfers, airlines, airports and payment methods;
• compare prices for air tickets in different companies, both with transfers and direct flights;
• book a plane ticket online (there is a choice of currency and different payment methods).

How to use the app

1. Choose a simple or complex search method.
2. Select a departure date and a return date.
3. Select the number of passengers.
4. Set the price category of the flight - economy or business.
5. Click on the button below "Search tickets".
6. In search results, use filters and sort order of offers.
7. Go to the page with the best offer.
8. Next, you can go to the airline's website and book a plane ticket online.

We do not set prices for air tickets and do not charge additional markups.
